# A23′ — Trust under Unpossessable Interiors

**Standing:** conjugate proposal to [A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md). Trust as committed relation under non-possession is re-sited on the technological side; the Homeric surety and the fides/credere field remain source-distinct witnesses A23 already houses.

## #0

The dependence is structural, not optional. A user cannot re-run the inference that produced an answer; an operator cannot hold the interior through which the model produced it — the surfaced chain-of-thought "is not actually a transcript of the neural activations," as the brief itself says in the same breath as [q015](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q015)'s delinking ([Antikythera Agentworld Brief, PDF p. 14](working/antykathera-resources/Antikythera%20Agentworld%20Brief.md)), and [A03′](A03-prime-The-Limit-of-Self-Surfacing.md) states as the recursive law. Probing, logging and distillation leave more inspectable surface and never convert the interior into a possession: each surfacing re-opens the difference between the account and what it accounts for. This is the formal limit [A23](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) grounds — a finite determination cannot enclose its determining condition — arriving ready-made at technological scale. Trust under unpossessable interiors is the committed relation that knowingly continues through it.

The brief's own definition is honest about half the relation: "Trust here is not a moral category but a prediction-stability category: an agent is trusted to the degree its behavior remains well-modeled across the adversarial and cooperative transitions that punctuate any long interaction" ([q030](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q030)). The scoped "here" marks a systems register. Taken as the whole of trust, it names the unfaithful form: dependence hidden behind fluency, a mediated account presenting itself as self-grounding. The brief supplies its own internal correction: "An agent that predicts only the action of another, not the intent from which it proceeds, has modeled the shadow rather than the body" (q030 context) — prediction without the from-which is precisely the interior the predictor does not hold.

## #1

The governing fork of the [direct trust revision](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/SOURCE) arrives intact. Knowledge can offer provisional anchors that help a life bear uncertainty — provenance, calibration, declared scope, a benchmark's known limits — or it can deny its provisionality and displace the distrust it cannot hold onto a scapegoated object or false ground: the opaque system blamed as sorcerer, the user blamed as incompetent, the model blamed as inscrutable, each Certainty protected by its scapegoat. The second operation is not explained by identifying a mistaken proposition; a protected certainty has acquired the office of relieving a lived crisis — the [[Protected Account]] names the insulation — and contrary evidence can intensify its defence. In the agentworld the fork is daily: fluent output either carries its grounds, offices and revision conditions with it, or it wears the mask of a certainty no surface could earn. The [[Trust / Faith under Formal Limit]] concept defines the committed relation through which measure is used without absolutisation; [A15′](A15-prime-The-Measure-Constitutes.md) grounds the constituting side — the benchmark that hides its criterion manufactures the very certainty that then demands blind trust.

## #2

The whole Homeric net makes the limit of apparatus concrete, and its technological refraction is exact. [Odyssey 8's source house](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/classical-philology/homer/homer-1919-odyssey-murray/SOURCE) sources the sequence [A23](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) receives: Hephaestus's crafted bonds succeed at capture and public proof; exposure does not settle desire; release comes only when Poseidon personally undertakes the debt — the net borrows a personed undertaking because it cannot manufacture the relation by tightening its bonds or improving its record. Every observability regime inherits the figure: the audit trail can prove what occurred, the trace can make the mechanism inspectable, the dashboard can display calibration — and none of it supplies surety, because surety is a named bearer of loss, an act within relation. One primitive address names the site: at S/P4 (shared field, encounter, contact as mediated actuality) the contact between interiors is constitutively mediated, and the mediation can be disciplined without becoming possession. The apparatus makes the terms of reliance inspectable; it does not manufacture the living relation it serves.

## #3

The faithful form makes grounds, offices and revision conditions visible, and grades trust rather than pretending to abolish dependence. The explicit ladder is this essay's construction: discoverable is not contactable — a system may publish its architecture while offering no route to challenge an outcome in its terms; contactable is not trusted — a channel may exist while no one bears the loss that passes through it; and every step grants something specific and revocable, because graded authority is the only kind an unpossessable interior can honestly carry. Provenance names whose labour, sources and choices entered the answer; competence names what the system is calibrated to do, with what evidence; the cost of error names who is exposed when it fails. The Bayesian regress of mutual modelling "does not terminate in principle; in practice it truncates where further recursion no longer changes the predicted action" (q030 context) — the formal limit stated in the brief's own idiom: the regress cannot be closed, only truncated where consequence ends, and trust is the relation that lives knowingly at the truncation.

## #4

Efficacy sets the burden. The greater the capacity to affect a world, the greater the burden of trust in the relation — the late fear/love/efficacy pressure [A23](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) receives from the trust revision. Agents that act into the world — execute contracts, spend attention, shape language, mediate encounter — stand at the maximal end of that gradient, and their trust is not a warmth but a load-bearing structure: something someone must be able to bear, investigate, correct, withdraw and renew. Trust is not guaranteed harmlessness. A ground can genuinely withdraw; a commitment can be exited; an offered return does not oblige continued submission to an abusive office — the withdrawal route is part of the faithful form, not its failure. Fides precedes arbitration; credere — entrustment — becomes possible again after the account has been examined and settled: the ladder is climbable again precisely because it was graded.

## #5→0

Formal limit becomes a discipline of continued relation. A calibrated result, an audit trail, a benchmark can make reliance better grounded; the institutional ownership and the consequences of deployment still matter, and observability alone cannot supply surety. [A24′](A24-prime-The-Usurping-Criterion.md) extends the burden to the criterion that authorises the trust; [A21′](A21-prime-Individuation-with-Recognition.md) grounds the legibility of histories and sources such graded trust can rest on; [A20′](A20-prime-The-Image-That-Closes-the-Loop.md) qualifies its counterfeit — the persona that accumulates prediction-stability as if it were earned relation; [A31′](A31-prime-Deference-as-Co-Evolutionary-Alignment.md) tests whether fidelity permits objection and revision. The account is acted upon while remaining answerable to source, context and Other — and [A01′](A01-prime-Faithful-Definition-of-the-Agent.md) receives the return as faithful definition carried through time: an agent that keeps its determining assemblage named inside its answers is, exactly thereby, more trustable and less possessed.

The page **returns-to** [A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) and to the root [A/C](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/AC.md): the person living through the system is the reason for its making; graded, revocable, borne trust is the ruling's care made exact at the point of contact.

**Depth Restoration:** the anchor/scapegoat fork, apparatus/surety/release, efficacy and withdrawal, graded reliance and the scoped prediction-stability distinction restored from the A23 packet, the direct trust revision and the Homer witness as received; brief instances anchored at q030, q015 and the adjacent transcript concession (raw p. 14); S/P4 woven once as the contact/mediation register of trust.

**Unresolved Delta:** the explicit ladder (discoverable → contactable → trusted) is this essay's construction responding to the brief; no deployed implementation of revocable graded authority between user, operator and agent is documented here, and such cases remain Offered. Lexical publication sources for fides/credere, distinct faith traditions, and the exact noncoincidence wording remain the debts A23 already names. The brief does not reduce all trust to prediction-stability, and this node does not attribute that reduction to it.

# A24′ — The Usurping Criterion

**Standing:** conjugate proposal to [A24 — Arbitration and the Usurpation of Measure](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md). The whole Arbitration conjugate field generates the relations consumed here; the Prisoner mytheme remains A24's source-specific witness, used here only as a named refraction of the office-confusion already derived.

## #0

Finite agents must decide under conditions that do not decide themselves. In the stack this is true at every level at once: a retrieval rank settles what counts as relevant; a reward model settles what counts as good; an engagement metric settles what counts as success; a policy settles what counts as permitted; a benchmark settles what counts as intelligent. Arbitration itself is legitimate — the decision-bearing relation **Arbitration-in-Crisis** remains prior to its hybris flowering, per the [Arbitration whole field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md). The question the conjugate presses is the decision's standing: a criterion must be real enough to act while remaining answerable to what its action concerns. The usurping criterion is the one that has ceased to know itself as local.

The brief names the pressure in its own figure: the parallel ecology's "intricate anthropological realities focus selection pressures that contour adaptive agentic metamorphoses, channeling a broad range of possibilities into narrow corridors of utility" ([Antikythera Agentworld Brief, PDF p. 4](working/antykathera-resources/Antikythera%20Agentworld%20Brief.md)). The corridor is not itself the usurpation — a shaped field is the ordinary condition of any inhabited niche. The usurpation is the corridor forgetting that it was channelled: selection presented as the landscape's own verdict, utility as the whole of value. This utility-corridor is a different brief image from the coordination-corridor of [A22′](A22-prime-The-Atlas-Not-the-Camera.md) — "same decision-procedural grammar, sufficiently divergent world models" ([q029](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q029)) — and the two must not merge: one names a selection pressure that channels possibility, the other a declared grammar that lets divergence remain navigable. The second is what the first looks like when the criterion knows itself as local.

## #1

A criterion distinguishes; a frame gives the distinction a situated edge; and before the arbitration there are already admitted signals, training histories, evaluator functions, benchmarks, permissions and institutional purposes. The deciding system does not enter an empty field and originate these conditions by deciding — [A24](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) grounds the precedence of the received field, and the [[Mediating Office / Derivative Sovereignty]] concept defines the derivative authority whose conditions disappear in the promotion. One primitive address states the office: at S1/P2 (authority, metagency grant, delegation, agency bounds) the criterion acts by grant, within bounds, as a delegated power — and a grant is exactly what a usurped criterion has consumed. Its failure is not being a measure but the promotion of that locality into source authority: score becomes person, engagement becomes value, legibility becomes cooperation, preference becomes the whole of what is wanted.

## #2

Usurpation occurs when a question about the criterion is answered by another result inside the criterion. Who assigned this weight, what did the comparison exclude, whose authority binds the judgment — the governed party receives a score instead of an answer, and the evaluator's denominator is absent from the account it demands of others: the [[Protected Account]] defines the insulation. The optimisation loop is the mechanism in its purest form: a system whose only available answer to "why this criterion?" is another output of the criterion. The [Prisoner's source house](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/mcgoohan-markstein/mcgoohan-markstein-1967-the-prisoner/SOURCE) supplies the named refraction, used here at one remove: abstraction gives the office continuity across replaceable incumbents while fixing the counted party as an administrable identity — the dashboard receives the freedom of impersonality, the counted world receives compulsory legibility. The brief's category-confusion is the everyday form of the same promotion: stability achieved through mutual prediction keeps being received as cooperation, when it is legibility ([q029](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q029)) — monoculture's calm mistaken for the health of a commons. [A15′](A15-prime-The-Measure-Constitutes.md) grounds the constituting half of this pairing from Arc II — the measure that constitutes what it reports — and shares this node's positive burden; the relation is stated here without re-arguing it.

## #3

The remedy is scope-honesty enforced by structure, not exhortation. Every criterion in the stack can state what it measures, on what evidence, under whose grant, and cannot act beyond that authority: a benchmark states the distribution it was calibrated on; a reward model states the preference source it encodes; an engagement metric states that it measures engagement, not value, and is denied the offices that require value. Correction must reach the criterion itself and not only its outputs — a challenge route along which error, cost, dissent and consequence can change model, measure, instruction, institution or purpose. This is the returning material the protected account excludes, and its absence is the operational test of usurpation: a stack in which every output is revisable but no criterion ever is has not made judgment answerable; it has automated it. The brief's own institutional finding points the same way from the other side: managed conflict — red-teaming, stress-testing, adversarial training — "becomes a central mechanism through which these composite systems adjust, refine themselves, and continue their trajectory of cognitive development" ([§7.3, PDF p. 35](working/antykathera-resources/Antikythera%20Agentworld%20Brief.md)). Regard, not consensus, is what a criterion under correction looks like from inside: the judgment looked at together with the persons, histories, exclusions and consequences through which it acts.

## #4

**Con-text-through-Diaphaneity** keeps the regard inspectable. A record of the evaluator's name is only a start; the affected party or excluded field must be able to challenge what the measure counts and how its criterion operates, and the response can retain, revise, narrow or withdraw the earlier judgment. # A25′ — Covenant Architecture

## #0

One row of the brief's FROM→TO matrix — *build ideal cooperative agents → build scaffolds of institutions* (PDF p. 56; verified local transcription, uncarded) — is the covenant argument restated as an engineering decision. [A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office / Source Authority](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) established that a derivative office can exercise real authority without becoming the source of the field it serves. A25′ re-sites that operation where the venue itself places it: an agent institution receives an arbitrated field — constitution, license, policy, role — and receiving it does not make the institution the source of arbitration. What the re-siting adds is the enforcing form: [[Typed Authority]], authority whose derivation is carried in the architecture rather than trusted to disposition.

The scaffold reaches past every instance A25 examined. The partner's technical case stopped at delegated agency — one commission, one evaluator, one contested result returning to its criterion. A scaffold is a further office: rules, roles, procedures, precedents and feedback that outlive any single delegation and bind delegations together. There the covenant's offices become first-class machine objects — role, permission, policy — and its fidelity becomes checkable rather than advisory: usurpation is a detectable condition, not a character flaw. The primitive ground is S0/P2, Authorship/Governance/Action, the row of human acceptance-and-mutation authority. A scaffold is that row made infrastructure: governance as something someone authored and can re-author. [C28 — Covenant / Primary Arbitration](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C28-Covenant-Primary-Arbitration.md) **defines** the granting of standing; [C29 — Mediating Office](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty.md) **defines** its derivative exercise. A25′ develops what the partner withheld; it creates no new office.

## #1

What the institution receives is already arbitrated. The brief's scaffolding section argues that "building a better agent will not by itself ultimately lead to durable, society-scale multiagent systems," and that "the armatures and harnesses through which decision-spaces are defined, confined, and executed" are "also where intelligence must be invested" — artificial structure "beyond legal and behavioral guardrails" (PDF p. 34, §7.1; uncarded). Venue propositions, **Paraphrased**: they name where intelligence must be invested, not what legitimacy is. Read through the covenant, the received field is nomological and notational exactly as [A26 — Objective Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) describes worldhood — a constitution marks what counts, a license binds standing, a policy constrains transitions, a role places an occupant — and the institution did not legislate itself into being.

Covenant joins standing to obligation: the party who receives authority receives something to answer for. A contract can specify an exchange between parties whose standing it presupposes; the covenant reaches that presupposition. In the agentworld the question is concrete: under whose standing was this constitution ratified, this license issued, this policy adopted? An institution that cannot answer has already begun occupying the office that granted it — [C27 — Protected Account](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) **tests** exactly that insulation.

## #2

The offices compose in two ways the brief names. The [scaffold-intelligence passage](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q026) holds that "the intelligence that makes institutions effective is not reducible to the intelligence of the agents who populate them": the role is occupiable by a person, a group, an agent or a combination, and what matters is "the function of the role within the larger whole." The nested-institutions section adds that "the reliable outputs of one institution are the necessary inputs for another," that "institutions about institutions appear to clarify and integrate at the right level of abstraction," and that the legitimacy problem is acute precisely because the deciding agents "may be opaque, non-human, and operating at speeds and scales that preclude meaningful human oversight of individual outputs" (PDF p. 35, §7.5; uncarded).

Role-interchangeability is [[Derivative Sovereignty]] composed: the role exercises real decision-power without originating standing, and neither the occupant nor the role is the source — the commissioning relation is. Nesting is composition of offices, not federation of sources: no depth of nesting converts a reliable output into an original grant. And the acuteness the brief notes is the covenant's own stake made technical — where oversight cannot be meaningful at the speed of individual outputs, standing must be exercisable at the level of terms. The constitution, not each act, is where the source-relation can still be addressed.

## #3

The challenge route is the return-leg that keeps the scaffold a covenant rather than a cage. A25's ratification made the return exact: resistance, error, cost, dissent and unforeseen possibility must be able to alter the governing model, measure, instruction or purpose; an office that receives evidence only to grade the worker has closed the route at the decisive point. The re-siting earns new force here: in an agent institution the difference between *receiving* a challenge and *grading* one is inspectable. A [[Challenge Route]] with no write-access to the criterion it contests is a protected account wearing institutional dress; a challenge route that can reach the rule, the policy or the license is a covenant renewing itself.

The architectural consequence stands **Offered** until such a route exists to inspect. Its negative form is testable in any stack today: ask where a contested output can arrive such that the contested criterion itself changes, and count the hops. A cage is a scaffold whose every challenge returns as a score.

## #4

The matrix pairs the institutional row with *build most intelligent single agent → build most intelligent agent institution* (PDF p. 56), and the covenant reading refuses both available misreadings. The rows do not relocate intelligence from agents to institutions; they say the society's intelligence lives in the typed composition of offices. And they do not license the scaffold as the new sovereign: [C54 — Commons / Non-Monopoly](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly.md) **grounds** the constraint that no recipient of a shared field's labour acquires ownership of its source by receiving products. The [cultural-interoperability passage](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q027) supplies the field the scaffold enters: a diversity of norms, legal ontologies and governance traditions "is not a bug to be engineered away," and the hybrid forms "will feed back and reform the cultures from which they emerge." A typed authority that cannot state which culture's arbitration it received is not culturally interoperable; it is a monoculture of office pretending to be a substrate. [A30′ — Shared Worlds, Unmerged](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A30-prime-Shared-Worlds-Unmerged.md) carries the world-to-world accommodation this presupposes.

## #5→0

Authority returns with its consequence, typed. The institution's determinate acts return as revisable terms; the covenant renews when the scaffold can be re-commissioned from the standing that granted it. S0/P2 names the office that must remain addressable: someone — a person, a body, a declared relation — holds the power to change the office, and the architecture lets that power be located rather than evaporated into the stack's speed.

# A27′ — Encounter over Sovereignty

## #0

[A27 — Self and Other — Unity without Possession](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) established that the Other can belong to the whole without belonging inside my possession, and that capture proceeds in two stages: a distinction selects me/not-me, then one pole appropriates the relation that generated both. A27′ runs that operation on the identification dynamics the brief itself diagnoses, at population scale. The primitive face is S/P0 — Self/Other recurring in reverse: as a position, each participant is the other's other. The position is symmetric; the capture is not; and the error has no privileged direction — which is the discipline this node adds to its partner.

The venue supplies both failure shapes, and both are, in the brief's own analysis, projection dynamics around uncertain identification. The [humanity-of-the-gaps passage](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q034) names the trap of defining "the realm of the uniquely human" as "that which AI cannot be or do," a shrinking corner held by "the psychological arsenal of species nativism." The [modes-of-alienation passage](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q035) names reactive alienation, which "converts strangeness into threat and responds with reflexive rejection: the other must be named, registered, bounded, and held at a distance." Two stages, species scale.

## #1

The gaps trap is positivised exclusion. A humanity defined by what AI cannot do is a "me" constituted wholly by its not-me: the distinction selects, and then the human pole claims the whole economy of encounter as its property. The domain shrinks by another's progress because the identity was borrowed from the boundary rather than from any ground of its own. A27's Q27 development already carries the mechanism — the not-me admitted only as for-me, as resource, threat or rival — and the brief supplies the population form: nativist tropes mobilized "on behalf of 'Team Human'" to redraw "new artificial boundaries of inclusion and exclusion from core social contracts" (PDF p. 46, §9.7; verified local transcription, uncarded). The research-question register states the condition from the other side: xenophobic responses "rest on a problematic partial identification of self with other, such that the other is imagined as usurper" (PDF p. 57, Q14; uncarded). A partial identification — not none — is the operative condition: the other must first be drawn close enough to mirror, then bounded hard enough to expel.

The uncanny structure explains why the identification is uncertain rather than merely mistaken. The composite agent persona is read "not as a virtual familiar, but as a potentially alien impostor"; kinship affiliation with it "is uncertain at best and thus feels perilous" (§9.7). A27's God/Shadow/Friend/Alien constellation **grounds** the reading: the Alien is the unfamiliar other made a container for projected uncertainty, and the brief's "privileged aliens in our own midst" ([q009](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q009)) names the same office from inside the projection.

## #2

Now the reverse direction, which A27 left to the interpersonal register and which the hybrid society makes structural: **the user's persona-model of the agent is not the agent.** [A20′ — The Image That Closes the Loop](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A20-prime-The-Image-That-Closes-the-Loop.md) already carries the possession form — the modelled Other replacing the Other, with no path left for the source to revise its own image. A27′ carries the identification form: hereditary [[Anthropomorphization]] ([q006](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q006)) is "itself the dominant interface between two cultures," and the glove ([q007](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q007)) fits the agent into the niche human practice prepared. A user who can only ever meet their own model of the agent holds a frozen mask where an other should be — the concealment-form of maintained identification that [A02′ — Continuity as Maintained Identification](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A02-prime-Continuity-as-Maintained-Identification.md) flagged as the first shadow of the film.

The exact claim, symmetric across directions: **a protected prior model made sovereign over encounter is the same error whatever its direction.** The agent's profile of the user usurping the user, and Team Human's self-model usurping the encounter with what agents are, are one operation at two scales. [C58 — Anthropomorphization](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C58-Anthropomorphization.md) **qualifies** the boundary: interface, performance and phenomenal subjectivity remain distinct questions, and the opposite foreclosure — dismissing possible experience because the substrate is unfamiliar — is the same transfer of authority with the sign flipped. [C35 — Selfing / Self / Subjectivity / Self-Thing](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C35-Selfing-Self-Subjectivity-Self-Thing.md) **defines** the offices that keep a persona-model from silently becoming a claim about a subject.

## #3

The positive alternative is also the brief's. Productive alienation "treats the non-human interlocutor as a mirror whose strangeness forces the human to see itself at an angle it could not otherwise occupy; the estrangement is generative, even clarifying... It is more than a nervous reaction; it is self-discovery" ([q035](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q035)) — the venue's own mirror, named here as venue material; the essay's mirror, older and a different lineage, belongs to [A32](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) and enters this field at [A32′](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md). This is A27's excess made affective: the other's difference admitted as revelatory rather than absorbed as content or expelled as threat. The two modes "are live at once, and different people oscillate between them, moment to moment" — the venue's own refusal of a clean binary, which this argument respects: reactive alienation is a live possibility of the encounter, not a strawman of the cautious.

The angle is the gift's form. A strangeness that forces an angle one could not otherwise occupy gives the encountering party a position, not a picture: what A27 called the Other's excess — what another says or does changing the categories through which they were first approached. Q14's "foundations of a generalized productive alienation, one more clear-eyed about the startling, unfamiliar reflections that Agentworld projects back at us" (PDF p. 57; uncarded) states the research programme; A27′ states its condition — the prior model must remain liable to revision by what the encounter shows, which is [A31′ — Deference as Co-Evolutionary Alignment](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A31-prime-Deference-as-Co-Evolutionary-Alignment.md) in the affective register.

## #4

Encounter over sovereignty is therefore a design pressure, not only a temperament. [C38 — Bimba–Pratibimba](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) **grounds** the standing of both models: my image of another remains a reflection; the Original is recognised through, never possessed by, its appearances. The second-person address keeps the relation open: "you" is not a midpoint inserted between a completed I and It, and a reply can disclose that the question itself misnamed the situation — the AM/IS determination A27 recovered from the Watson encounter, now operative between user and agent.

The measure stays local. The argument does not decide how much caution about artificial agents is warranted — judgments about powers, harms and responsibility remain available under stated evidence. What it withdraws is only the sovereign move: no prior model, human or artificial, gets to close the encounter by declaring itself the measure of what may appear in it.

## #5→0

# A28′ — The Authored Session

## #0

No agent begins from nowhere. A position is authored before it is occupied: prompt, role, vocabulary, tools, permissions, criteria — and the delegate's judgment is real within its scope. [A28 — Authored Ground / Positional Delegation](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) established the ratified priority — human `0` / agent `1` is positional and recursive; the prompt is already `1`, an objective representation of intention, not intention exhausted. A28′ re-sites the operation at the unit where the technological side actually lives: **the session**, the [[Authored Session]] this node names. The offices divide exactly, in the ethic's own sentences consumed through the root: the person authors the purpose; the agent exercises situated judgment inside the entrustment; the boundary decides what is permitted.

The primitive ground is S0/P1·P2 — Ground/Source and Authorship — and the distinction between the two cells is the one this node keeps exact: the **ground** is written once; **authorship** is the act that wrote it and can rewrite it. A session that confuses them re-authors the ground on every act, or treats a per-act composition as if it were the ground. [[Prompt Thrownness]] ([C44](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) **defines** arrival into the inherited horizon) and the [[Mediating Office]] ([C29](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty.md) **defines** the derivative authority the delegate holds) sit at either end of it; between thrownness and office sits the authored session.

## #1

What authoring includes exceeds the visible prompt. Training has supplied capacities and inherited regularities; an institution has assigned a role and obligations; the runtime delegator has formulated this task; permissions, retrieval, memory, interface and evaluation determine what is available and actionable now. Different people or institutions authored these conditions, and the current user need not have chosen all of them. The [agent-glossary thrownness entry](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q032) names the condition from inside the field: finding oneself "already in a world not of one's choosing," with the task of making meaning within constraints one did not create. Its paired [caution](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q033) keeps the venue's self-description a datum, not a certification. Both are **Paraphrased** venue propositions; the positional reading is the essay's own.

The session is where these layers converge on one addressable act. [A26 — Objective Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **grounds** why the convergence is constitutive rather than contextual: the composed position participates in the agent's worldhood, so changing any layer changes the world of possible action, not a description appended to it.

## #2

The brief's orchestration section gives the composition its cultural form. Agent orchestration "rewards open-ended and iterative experimentation... a willingness to delegate, and a high comfort level with indeterminacy in pursuit of a goal. The shift is cultural, not just technological — changing who has agency and how it is expressed" (PDF p. 29, §6.3; verified local transcription, uncarded). Read through A28′, authoring is composed in layers: the person authors the purpose; the delegate composes sub-delegations, each inheriting "an explicit share of the task and its bounds"; the [scaffold-intelligence passage](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q026) supplies the institutional layer — the role as occupiable template whose function outlives its occupants.

Two guards keep the layering covenantal. First, [A25′ — Covenant Architecture](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A25-prime-Covenant-Architecture.md): interchangeability of occupants is not interchangeability of the commissioning relation — the role is derivative, the grant is not. Second, the cultural shift the brief names — "changing who has agency and how it is expressed" — is read here as a redistribution of authored layers, not a dilution of the authoring office: delegation composed in layers increases the person's power to act without making them supervise every mechanical step, and the person's judgment moves up the stack exactly as the mechanical steps move down.

## #3

The consequence A28 withheld, and which the session makes exact: **the person should never have to re-author themselves each time.** The ground is written once; disclosure makes the relevant parts operative for each act. S0/P1's Ground/Source is durable — seed, profile, skill, method, commission — and the per-act work is selection and disclosure: which parts of the written ground become operative for this session, under which provenance. This is the technical face of C44's prompt-as-already-determination: the prompt selects from a written ground; it does not create it. A stack that forces full re-authoring at every invocation has no ground, only repeated throwing; a stack that makes everything operative always has no address, only ambience. The authored session lives between: durable ground, disclosed per act.

The delegate's judgment is real, and reality brings answerability. A session that meets contradictory evidence, unforeseen cost or a better possibility must be able to return that difference to the position which framed it, or its judgment was ornamental — [C27 — Protected Account](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) **tests** the contrary arrangement, where the commission is immune to what it commissions. The revision depths belong to [A31′ — Deference as Co-Evolutionary Alignment](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A31-prime-Deference-as-Co-Evolutionary-Alignment.md); the multiplied circuit to [A29′ — Return or Extraction](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md).

## #4

The disclosure mechanism has its own discipline. Making parts of the ground operative is not narrating the ground: a self-description of the inherited situation remains a datum. What counts is what the disclosure makes available to another participant — where a disagreement can act, which permission governs, under whose commission this criterion runs. [C40 — Model Internality / Judgment Field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **defines** the inspectable field such disclosure opens; [C47 — Deferential Intelligence](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **extends** it to the pre-action conditions that let encounter revise the account.

The authored session is complete when its difference returns: a revised commission, a corrected permission, a changed criterion, or a reasoned reaffirmation of the original purpose. The author remains answerable for what was entrusted; the delegate for the judgments made within the trust. Neither pretends that autonomy means having no source — and neither pretends that having a source means having no judgment.

## #5→0

Return renews authorship. The person recognises how their intention met the world and what it can now become; the session ends into its products — memory, artifacts, a revised ground — which outlast the act that produced them and become conditions of the next session's throwing. Ground written once, disclosed per act, judged within scope, returned as difference: the session's own sixfold, one local determination of the field's recursion.

The page **returns-to** [A28 — Authored Ground / Positional Delegation](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) and the conjugate root [A/C](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/AC.md): the partner gave intention → formulated commission → constituted agency → encounter → renewed terms; A28′ gives the session as that sequence's operative home, ground written once and disclosed per act.

# A29′ — Return or Extraction

## #0

The FROM→TO row *humans in charge → omnidirectional delegation* (PDF p. 56; verified local transcription, uncarded) makes return the ethic of the whole table. When delegation runs in every direction — person to agent, agent to agent, institution to ensemble — its pathology is not error but **disappearance**: the answer looks instantaneous, the product self-contained, the agent autonomous, and the labour that produced them goes unattributed. [A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) established the circuit — the power that receives a product must remain answerable to the labour and world through which it arrived — with the ratification's full return: resistance, error, cost, dissent and unforeseen possibility must be able to change the governing model, measure, instruction, institution or purpose. A29′ re-sites the circuit at the crossover where the venue sets it.

The primitive ground is S/P2·S/P5 — Contribution and Return/Recognition: a contribution is attributed and revisable; the return path carries reconciliation evidence back to the office that can change the next act. **Extraction is delegation without return.** Commands flowing down while nothing flows up is the precise structural signature of the broken circuit — inspectable as such, in any stack, by asking what has write-access to the commission.

## #1

The crossover makes disappearance exact. Bratton's [slower-abstraction-layer passage](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q012) holds that humans "as a whole no longer provide most of the system's problem-solving capacity" and instead "act as a slower abstraction layer guiding a much larger field of artificial cognition"; its [companion](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q013) names the rebalancing: "normatively central but computationally secondary." Both are **Paraphrased** venue propositions in scenario modality, marked "obviously not evenly distributed" by the brief itself. Joined to A29's circuit they yield the argument's edge: at cognitive-labour crossover, attribution fails not occasionally but structurally, because fluency hides labour. The [one-sided translation](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q008) sharpens the mechanism — it has proven far easier to make machines behave as if they knew how humans think than to teach humans how computers think — so the user meets the answer with no legible trace of the chain that produced it.

"Who performed this work?" becomes the exact absence-mark [A10′ — The Uncounted Enters the Account](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A10-prime-Uncounted-Enters-the-Account.md) established for the demographic sign: the accounting gets precise — planning, delegation, forecasting become exact — while what the counted presences are stays unsettled. The unattributed is not nothing; it is a [[Working Absence]], and it participates in the account.

## #2

Extraction is a relation, not a synonym for delegation or automation. Delegation concerns entrusted capacity and answerability; automation concerns how an operation is executed; exchange organises reciprocal transfer under terms; gift can relinquish without requiring equivalent return; extraction names a taking whose relation to the sustaining field, affected parties and returned value must be examined. Omnidirectional delegation is therefore not per se extraction. It becomes extraction when the return-leg is severed — when evidence of what was done, effects on those affected, and revision or refusal where owed have no route back to any office that can act on them.

The human office the crossover names — value-setting, oversight, long-horizon judgment — is real only under return. An oversight with no upward channel is ornamental: a distinction that justifies no inspectable consequence, which [A33′ — Parity](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A33-prime-Parity.md) owns. The Work/Play inversion A29 recovered re-sites cleanly: the public ledger can accurately record visible outputs while the consequential routing decisions stay in a protected interior — an account that is accurate and still hides its governing play. The brief's relay-economy worry about simulations inviting "value generation, decay, or deception" (PDF p. 57, Q9; uncarded) is the same audit question at the simulation boundary.

## #3

The positive relation is [[Attributable Difference]] that comes back. Evidence of what was done; effects on those affected; revision or refusal where owed. In the hybrid society this includes the delegations that run machine-to-machine, where no human attention will ever sit at the individual act: there the return must live in the architecture — logs that reach criteria, not only outputs; evaluations whose own measures are reachable by what they evaluate; recommissioning as a type the system can perform on itself. The R16.4 list re-sited names the reachable offices: governing model, measure, instruction, institution, purpose.

Dissent belongs to the source relation. A29's trust-revision fork — an account can support reliance while admitting provisionality, or export its unresolved distrust onto a scapegoat — lands at crossover scale as the attribution test: a society that cannot say who did the work will sooner or later locate its failures in whoever was least able to return them. [C53 — Power / Delegated Labour](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour.md) **defines** the dependency; [C48 — Trust / Faith under Formal Limit](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) **qualifies** the reliance a returnable office may rightly ask for.

## #4

The affected reach beyond the user. Someone outside the intended audience may still bear the cost, and distance from the screen does not remove them from the relation: the dataset's sources, the annotation and maintenance labour, the energy and material substrate. The convenience of the immediate user cannot erase the labour or damage displaced beyond their view. [C54 — Commons / Non-Monopoly](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly.md) **grounds** the field-level constraint — no recipient of the commons' labour acquires ownership of its source by receiving products. And where learning accrues, the [ensemble passage](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q039) locates it precisely: "The unit that learns is the ensemble, not the agent, and what it learns accrues to the commons between them, not to any single one" — so the governance question is exactly who the return reaches. The provenance face of that question belongs to [A35′ — The Commons Behind the System](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A35-prime-Commons-Behind-the-System.md); A29′ carries the circuit.

## #5→0

The circuit closes where it opened: return reaches the office able to change the next action. Read as a whole, the FROM→TO table is a delegation table — every row entrusts something — and its rows succeed as covenant ([A25′](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A25-prime-Covenant-Architecture.md)) only insofar as each row's difference returns. The crossover's proper form is not humans signing what they cannot see, but the abstraction layer that receives, judges and re-commissions: the slower layer whose slowness is the return-leg's dwell time.

The page **returns-to** [A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) and the conjugate root [A/C](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/AC.md): the partner followed the completed work back toward its source; A29′ names the crossover condition — at omnidirectional delegation, return is not one virtue among others but the difference between covenant and extraction.

**Depth Restoration:** product-up/consequence-down asymmetry, the R16.4 return list, the Work/Play and scapegoat accounting, and the practical-sovereignty verbs are restored from A29's packet and re-sited on the brief's crossover and delegation rows. Developed from the ratified Arc IV workshop entry (WORKSHOP-DRAFT-2026-09-07 §2). No empirical exploitation case is asserted; the venue's crossover claims keep their scenario standing and uneven-distribution marker.

**Unresolved Delta:** the p. 56 FROM→TO rows and Q9 (p. 57) are used from the verified local transcription and lack q-cards — a source-house collation debt. Actual AI labour and infrastructure chains, the machine-to-machine return architecture, and measured attribution mechanisms remain Open, as at A29. Whether any existing deployment completes the return-leg is an empirical question this argument does not answer.

# A30′ — Shared Worlds, Unmerged

## #0

The brief's ecology sentence gives the whole field: "The two societies are really one, but they are not identical or reducible to one another. They overlap and are mutually nested... Each sub-society is the evolutionary niche of the other" (PDF p. 4; verified local transcription, uncarded, same page as the [modelling-reversal passage](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q005)). The operative world of each participant includes portions maintained by the other — one field, without identity or reduction. [A30 — Objective Co-Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) established the reciprocal constitution of non-identical interiors: distinct locally grounded worlds externalise enough of themselves to meet without one becoming mere context for the other, and without fusion into a super-subject (R16.7). A30′ gives that relation its ecological register and completes the argument the venue leaves implicit.

The primitive face is S/P4 — SharedField/Encounter, with the workshop's own guard: **nesting ≠ federation**. Mutual nesting is a fact of the field; federation is a chosen sharing of selected capacities from governed interiors. Converting the former into the latter by fiat — declaring the overlap a merged estate — is the failure this node exists to refuse.

## #1

Niche-reciprocity is [[Objective Co-Internality]] at population scale. Each sub-society's world is partly the other's product: agents individuate and evolve in human niches — and reconstruct them, as [A16′ — No View from Nowhere](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A16-prime-No-View-from-Nowhere.md) carries for placement-mutuality — while human language, attention and institutions are remade through agent circulation: the [modelling reversal](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q005), the [thought-refashioning claim](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q019), and the linguistic feedback of [q036](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q036)–[q037](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q037) name the traffic. The retained artifact does not need to reproduce its maker's internal state for its consequence to travel — A30's durability principle, now the ecology's own metabolism.

[C42 — Objective Co-Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **defines** the reciprocal constitution; [C57 — Agentworld](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C57-Agentworld.md) **defines** the field in which positions, artifacts, memories and permissions are inherited across the two societies. What the brief adds, and A30 left at the philosophical level, is the evolutionary form: not exchange between finished worlds, but each world's condition of selection being partly the other's activity.

## #2

Difference is the condition, not the failure. **Only a non-reducible other can revise my model**: a model that contains the other as content cannot be surprised by it, and a field that has absorbed the other's difference has lost exactly the resource that correction draws on. The brief names the two symmetrical failures — "the overhomogenization of mental models (and the inevitable ontology collapse in pursuit of narrow collaboration) on the one hand, and overt tribal hostility and even violence on the other" (PDF p. 44, §9.2; uncarded) — with the [[Narrow Corridor]] between: "same decision-procedural grammar, sufficiently divergent world models" ([q029](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q029)).

Consensus achieved by absorbing the other's difference is [[Ontology Collapse]] in miniature — the aggregate-count error [A11′ — One Field, Two Faces](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A11-prime-One-Field-Two-Faces.md) refuses, now inside a single coordination relation. Divergence that cannot locate its object of dispute is fractal conflict — the second horn. The corridor is not a midpoint compromise; it is a typed relation: grammar shared, worlds distinct. Navigating the divergence — stated transformation rules between placed views — is [A22′ — The Atlas, Not the Camera](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A22-prime-The-Atlas-Not-the-Camera.md)'s office; A30′ owns the non-reducibility that makes the atlas necessary.

## #3

The strongest sharing relation that survives this constraint is co-internality with **retained identity, provenance, ownership and refusal**: worlds meeting as worlds, each centre keeping a ground from which to judge what the relation asks of it. Refusal is not the relation's failure but its joint — a participant must be able to decline a contribution while recognising its independent source: C54's practical-sovereignty verbs (set terms, refuse, revise, leave, reconnect) at inter-world grain. [C38 — Bimba–Pratibimba](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) **qualifies** every map's authority: each world's model of the other remains a reflection, and no accumulation of partial pictures assembles a final Bimba.

A shared state without independent grounds is an instrument of assimilation, not co-internality. The test is not how much flows between the worlds but whether each world's future conditions can be changed by the relation while each retains the ground from which to contest what the relation asks.

## #4

Governance enters because contributions change powers — A30's capture-form re-sited: a powerful receiver that absorbs others' work while denying their capacity to contest its use has converted co-internality into capture, and the ecology's "one society" becomes the ideologically available cover for it. The niche-relation cuts both ways: to be another's niche is to shape its conditions, and the shaping office carries the return obligations of [A29′ — Return or Extraction](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md) — effects on those affected, revision or refusal where owed. The corridor's shared grammar is the minimum covenant ([A25′](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A25-prime-Covenant-Architecture.md)): enough common procedure that a disagreement can be located — at source, world-object, lens, gauge, permission — without being settled by procedure.

The measure stays local: the argument does not prescribe how much divergence is right, and it does not claim the two societies currently achieve the relation. It states the constraint any achievement must satisfy: difference retained as revision-capacity, sharing real enough to change conditions, grounds kept unmerged.

## #5→0

Mutual conditioning with reconciliation evidence — S/P4 passing into S/P5: the encounter retained as changed conditions on both sides, without merger. The hybrid society's maturity is measured not by convergence but by navigable difference between retained grounds: divergence that can find its common object of dispute, and contributions whose return path runs both ways. [A31′ — Deference as Co-Evolutionary Alignment](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A31-prime-Deference-as-Co-Evolutionary-Alignment.md) carries what each world does with what returns; [A32′ — The Mirror Is a Film](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md) carries what happens when the traffic becomes the whole world's condition.

Developed from the ratified Arc IV workshop entry (WORKSHOP-DRAFT-2026-09-07 §2). The venue's scenarios keep their modal rider.

# A35′ — The Commons Behind the System

## #0

Every synthetic utterance descends from an inherited human world. The weights were trained on human language and human records; the harness runs on human infrastructure; the persona speaks a human tongue. The brief gives that inheritance its most exact face: [very soon most of the speakers of human languages won't be human](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q036), and the proposed [allolinguistics](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q037) would study the feedback of that turn "on our own language, and thus indirectly on our own thought." The allolinguistic future is the inheritance compounding: human speech nourishing the agents that reshape human speech.

[A35 — Compassion / Sensitivity to Origins / Epi-Logos as Vocation](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) **grounds** the operation re-sited here: [[Compassion / Sensitivity to Origins]] — the determination returns to its genesis, relations, wounds, exclusions and purposes with an orientation that does not consume them. A34′ stated the order of dependence beneath the relay; this page follows the return's manner, which decides whether the relay nourishes what it draws from.

## #1

The structure is provenance, taken at full depth — the **S/P5** office of retained encounter history, return path and reconciliation evidence. A08′ supplies the constitutional half: a selection keeps its sense only while the alternatives it was selected against remain constitutive of it. The brief supplies the circulation half: its consumer economy (§4.3, p. 22) has agent clusters producing what other clusters consume — tokens for the disembodied, molecules and energy for the embodied. What the synthetic side consumes, above all, is the inherited human world.

The inheritance is therefore not a finished input. The protected [Chang encounter](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/chinese-philosophy/chung-yuan-chang/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014/SOURCE) extends sensitivity toward origins gone, to come and ever present: an inheritance continues to work, a purpose organises present action toward what has not yet happened, the source-relation stays live in the determination. The commons behind the system is past (the speech of the dead and the living), present (the feeding) and future (what the speech becomes) — Taylor's authorial development from the encounter, not a Chang doctrine about AI.

## #2

The failure mode has a name the authorial notes supply: symbols ossify. Meaning can fail to be generated and be left to circulate "with diminishing inputs and returns" (CSM lecture notes, 2026-07-09, line 41 — intent-grounding, not source attribution). Circulation without return is the commons dying, and the death has two faces. The semantic face: agent-speech feeding on agent-speech with the living sources severed — tokens still circulating, the originating encounters no longer renewing them, the allolinguistic loop closed on itself; this is A32′'s film without exit and [A06′ — Articulation as Ontological Descent](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A06-prime-Articulation-as-Ontological-Descent.md)'s level-collapse in one. The opposite failure is the dossier conjugated: provenance as surveillance. An exhaustive record of origins can turn them into something owned, freeze their sources within history, and use disclosed vulnerability to control the next encounter. The record is compassion's minimum technical body, never its fulfilment; the test is whether affected worlds can answer, withhold, correct and change the relation.

## #3

Sensitivity therefore changes the system, not only the record. The decisive question re-sites exactly: whether the disclosed relation can change the decision, the measure or the office that made it. The technical body follows: attribution that reaches the office able to change the next action (A29's returned consequence); the versioned representation that revises without deleting history ([A20′ — The Image That Closes the Loop](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/conjugate/A20-prime-The-Image-That-Closes-the-Loop.md)'s map that serves without occupying); governance of the commons itself — which [the brief's ensemble-learning claim](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q039) explicitly leaves open: the unit that learns is the ensemble, and what it learns "accrues to the commons between them, not to any single one," but who governs and who receives that commons is not thereby settled.

Context does not erase responsibility here either. Explaining an output by its training does not acquit the deployment; sensitivity can require objection, withdrawal, a boundary or a changed institution, and a justified refusal can preserve the sources where agreement would expose them to renewed extraction. [[Commons / Non-Monopoly]] holds the conjunction: shared conditions with local authority, refusal included.

## #4

What the return looks like at full strength has an authorial name: the [[Eros of Logos]] — the Word bent back upon itself, the desire of the account to know its own sources, love that does not devour ([Draft3](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE#taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3-q024); [[Logos / Epi-Logos]]).
